# Standard GRC Platform — Complete API Context

> This file contains the full API context for the Standard GRC Platform.
> Load this file to understand the entire API surface, authentication, endpoints, AI agents, and integration patterns.

---

## Overview

Standard is an API-first SaaS platform for executing security, compliance, and maturity assessments based on the Secure Controls Framework (SCF). The platform features 7 specialized AI agents that automate evidence evaluation, gap analysis, remediation planning, incident triage, vendor risk scanning, and executive reporting.

### Architecture

| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
|-------|-----------|---------+
| API Gateway | Cloudflare Workers | Edge-deployed REST API |
| Database | Neon PostgreSQL | Transactional store |
| Storage | Cloudflare R2 | Documents, reports, evidences |
| Vector Search | Cloudflare Vectorize | Semantic search for KB |
| AI Gateway | Cloudflare AI Gateway | LLM orchestration (gpt-4o) |
| Async Processing | Cloudflare Queues | Document ingestion, embeddings |

---

## Authentication

All protected endpoints require authentication via one of:

| Method | Header | Format |
|--------|--------|--------|
| API Key (M2M) | `Authorization` | `Bearer standard_live_<key>` |
| Browser Session | Cookie | `better-auth.session_token=<token>` |

**Tenant context** is required for all data endpoints:
```
x-standard-tenant-id: <organization_id>
```

### Example: Authenticated Request

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer standard_live_abc123" \
     -H "x-standard-tenant-id: org_456" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     https://standard-api-gateway-production.ness.workers.dev/api/v1/assessments
```

---

## Base URL

```
https://standard-api-gateway-production.ness.workers.dev
```

All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1`.

---

## Endpoints

### Health
- `GET /api/v1/health` — System health, version, uptime

### SCF Catalog (Read-Only)
- `GET /api/v1/scf/versions/latest` — Latest SCF version
- `GET /api/v1/scf/versions/{id}/domains` — List domains (33)
- `GET /api/v1/scf/versions/{id}/controls` — Search controls (1,468). Query params: `control_code`, `domain_code`, `q`, `tags`
- `GET /api/v1/scf/controls/by-code/{code}` — Lookup by control code
- `GET /api/v1/scf/frameworks` — List frameworks (231)
- `GET /api/v1/scf/frameworks/{id}/requirements` — Framework requirements
- `GET /api/v1/scf/controls/{id}/mappings` — Crosswalk mappings
- `GET /api/v1/scf/frameworks/{id}/coverage` — Coverage analysis

### Assessments
- `POST /api/v1/assessments` — Create assessment (body: `{ name, organization_id, scf_version_id }`)
- `GET /api/v1/assessments` — List assessments
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}` — Get assessment details
- `PATCH /api/v1/assessments/{id}` — Update assessment
- `DELETE /api/v1/assessments/{id}` — Delete assessment
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/summary` — **Server-computed KPIs**: compliance_pct, control counts, finding severities, open POAMs
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/compliance-gate` — CI/CD pass/fail gate

### Documents
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/documents` — Upload (multipart/form-data, field: `file`)
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/documents` — List documents
- `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/status` — Processing status
- `GET /api/v1/documents/{id}/chunks` — Document chunks
- `POST /api/v1/documents/{id}/reprocess` — Re-ingest

### Knowledge Base
- `POST /api/v1/kb/search` — Semantic search (body: `{ query, assessment_id, top_k?, min_score? }`)
- `GET /api/v1/kb/stats` — KB statistics
- `GET /api/v1/kb/chunks/{id}` — Chunk details

### Scope & SoA
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/scope` — Create scope
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/soa/draft` — Generate SoA
- `GET /api/v1/soa/{versionId}/items` — SoA items
- `PATCH /api/v1/soa/items/{itemId}` — Update item
- `POST /api/v1/soa/{versionId}/approve` — Approve SoA

### Gap Analysis
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/gap-analysis/draft` — Generate
- `GET /api/v1/gap-analysis/{versionId}/findings` — Findings
- `PATCH /api/v1/gap-analysis/findings/{findingId}` — Update finding
- `POST /api/v1/gap-analysis/{versionId}/approve` — Approve
- `GET /api/v1/gap-analysis/{versionId}/summary` — Summary stats

### POA&M
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/poam/draft` — Generate POA&M
- `GET /api/v1/poam/{versionId}/items` — POA&M items
- `PATCH /api/v1/poam/items/{itemId}` — Update item
- `POST /api/v1/poam/{versionId}/approve` — Approve

### Reports
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/reports/generate` — Generate report
- `GET /api/v1/reports/{id}/download` — Download
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/audit-package` — Generate audit-ready PDF + JSON + Markdown
- `GET /api/v1/export-jobs/{id}/download` — Download export job result

### Dashboard KPIs (Server-Computed)
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/summary` — Single assessment KPIs: compliance %, control counts, gap findings by severity, open POAMs, maturity avg
- `GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/dashboard` — Org-wide KPIs: total assessments, assessments by state, avg compliance %, total open POAMs, critical/high findings

### Audit Trail
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/audit-logs` — Assessment-level audit events
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{id}/audit-logs` — Tenant-wide audit events. Query: `?action=&actor_id=&resource_type=&since=&until=&limit=`
- `GET /api/v1/organizations/{id}/audit-logs` — Org-level audit events. Same query params.

### Member Management (RBAC)
- `POST /api/v1/organizations/{orgId}/members` — Invite member (body: `{ email, role, display_name? }`)
- `GET /api/v1/organizations/{orgId}/members` — List org members
- `GET /api/v1/members/{memberId}` — Get member detail
- `PATCH /api/v1/members/{memberId}` — Update role (body: `{ role }`)
- `DELETE /api/v1/members/{memberId}` — Remove member (returns 204)

**Roles**: `owner`, `admin`, `assessor`, `auditor_readonly`, `contributor`

### Approvals
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/approvals` — List approvals
- `POST /api/v1/approvals/{id}/approve` — Approve (body: `{ comment? }`)
- `POST /api/v1/approvals/{id}/reject` — Reject (body: `{ reason }`)

### Lifecycle
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/lifecycle/transition` — State transition (body: `{ target_state }`)
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/lifecycle/events` — Event history

### Agent Runtime
- `GET /api/v1/agent-runtime/agents` — List available AI agents
- `POST /api/v1/assessments/{id}/agent-runs` — Start agent run
- `GET /api/v1/assessments/{id}/agent-runs` — List runs for assessment
- `GET /api/v1/agent-runs/{id}` — Get run details + output
- `POST /api/v1/agent-runs/{id}/complete` — Complete run with output

### Webhooks
- `POST /api/v1/organizations/{orgId}/webhooks` — Create webhook
- `GET /api/v1/webhooks/{id}/deliveries` — Delivery log

### API Keys
- `GET /api/v1/api-keys` — List keys
- `POST /api/v1/api-keys` — Create key
- `DELETE /api/v1/api-keys/{id}` — Revoke
- `POST /api/v1/api-keys/{id}/rotate` — Rotate

---

## AI Agents

Standard includes 7 specialized AI agents. Each uses gpt-4o with structured JSON output.

| Agent | Endpoint | Input | Output |
|-------|----------|-------|--------|
| Evidence Evaluator | `POST /api/v1/gap/evaluate-evidence` | `{ controlRequirement, evidenceDescription }` | `{ is_compliant, confidence_score, missing_elements, auditor_notes }` |
| Incident Triager | `POST /api/v1/soc/triage-incident` | `{ rawLog, sourceSystem, timestamp }` | `{ is_false_positive, severity, containment_actions, privacy_breach_applicable }` |
| Board Translator | `POST /api/v1/executive/translate-risk` | `{ technicalRiskDescription, riskCategory, businessContext }` | `{ executive_summary, financial_impact_estimate, regulatory_impact, board_level_recommendation, urgency_metric }` |
| Vendor Scanner | `POST /api/v1/privacy/scan-vendor-contract` | `{ vendorName, contractExcerpt }` | `{ has_standard_contractual_clauses, is_dpa_compliant, liability_cap_identified, data_subprocessors_listed, red_flags_for_negotiation }` |
| PoAM Architect | `POST /api/v1/poam/architect-remediation` | `{ evidenceContext, systemArchitectureDescription }` | `{ priority_level, estimated_effort, sprint_action_items, devops_commands_suggested }` |
| RoPA Analyzer | `POST /api/v1/privacy/analyze-ropa` | `{ text }` | `{ suggested_risk_level, required_controls, suggested_legal_basis, is_dpia_required }` |
| DPIA Assessor | `POST /api/v1/privacy/assess-dpia` | `{ projectDescription, ropaContext }` | `{ residual_risk_level, is_approved_technically, mitigating_controls_required, justification }` |

### Agent Chaining Patterns

1. **Evidence → Remediation → Board**: Evaluate evidence → if non-compliant, generate PoAM → translate risk for board
2. **RoPA → DPIA**: Analyze data processing → if DPIA required, run deep assessment
3. **Incident → Board**: Triage security log → if real incident, translate for executives

---

## Assessment Lifecycle States

```
draft → documents_uploaded → documents_ingested → scf_pre_analysis_ready →
framework_selected → scope_drafted → soa_drafted → soa_under_review →
soa_approved → soa_ingested → evidence_analysis_ready →
gap_analysis_drafted → gap_analysis_under_review → gap_analysis_approved →
maturity_assessed → maturity_under_review → maturity_approved →
poam_drafted → poam_under_review → poam_approved →
report_generated → closed
```

**Approval gates** (require human approval): SoA, Gap Analysis, Maturity, POA&M.

---

## Full Assessment Flow (ISO 27001 Example)

A GRC consumer executes this sequence to run a complete compliance assessment:

```
Step  1: POST /assessments                          → Creates assessment
Step  2: POST /assessments/{id}/documents           → Upload evidence (repeat per file)
Step  3: POST /assessments/{id}/lifecycle/transition → target_state: "documents_uploaded"
Step  4: GET  /scf/frameworks                       → Find ISO 27001 framework_id
Step  5: POST /assessments/{id}/scope               → Define scope (systems, BUs, locations)
Step  6: POST /assessments/{id}/soa/draft           → AI generates SoA (320 controls mapped)
Step  7: GET  /soa/{versionId}/items                → Review AI results
Step  8: POST /soa/{versionId}/submit-review        → Submit for approval
Step  9: POST /assessments/{id}/gap-analysis/draft  → AI identifies compliance gaps
Step 10: GET  /gap-analysis/{versionId}/findings     → Review gaps by severity
Step 11: POST /assessments/{id}/poam/draft          → AI generates remediation plan
Step 12: GET  /poam/{versionId}/items               → Review actions with due dates
Step 13: GET  /assessments/{id}/summary             → Get final KPIs (compliance %)
Step 14: POST /assessments/{id}/audit-package       → Generate audit-ready export
```

---

## Error Format

All errors follow:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "Assessment not found.",
    "details": [],
    "trace_id": "abc-123-def"
  }
}
```

| Code | HTTP | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Missing or invalid authentication |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | Insufficient permissions |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Resource does not exist |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | Duplicate or conflicting state |
| `TENANT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED` | 400 | Missing `x-standard-tenant-id` header |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Invalid request body |
| `INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION` | 409 | Lifecycle state doesn't allow this action |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | 429 | Too many requests |

## Rate Limits

| Route | Max Requests | Window |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| `/documents` | 30 | 60s |
| `/kb/search` | 60 | 60s |
| `/agent-runs` | 10 | 60s |
| Default | 120 | 60s |

Version: 2026.1.1 | Controls: 1,468 | Frameworks: 231 | Requirements: 32,903 | Mappings: 15,717 | Domains: 33
